description.value: Blue Crab Seafood House is a waterfront seafood restaurant inside Coast Victoria Hotel & Marina by APA, perched at the edge of Victoria's Inner Harbour. The kitchen works daily with local fishmongers to source fresh Vancouver Island fish and shellfish, with chefs revealing new dish creations to the dining room just hours before service. Its combination of harbour views and a locally-driven menu makes it a distinctive full-service dining option on Victoria's Inner Harbour waterfront.
